paite: Huchi in amasapen in thilnget thumnate, thumna himhimte, thumsaknate, leh kipahthu gennate, mi tengteng a ding a bawlsak ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
heading: Saptuam Biakna
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

paite: Kumpipate leh thuneite tengteng a ding in leng; Pathian limsak leh zahtakhuaitak a kituak a khamuang a i omtheihna ding in.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

paite: Huai tuh i Hondampa Pathian theih in ahoih in, akipahhuai hi.
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

paite: Ama'n mi tengteng hotdam a om ding leh thutak thei ding in adeih hi.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

paite: "Pathian khat kia a om, Pathian leh mihing kikal ah palai khat kia a-om nawn,
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah mihing ahi, Khrist Jesu, mi tengteng tatna dia kipepa pen." Huai theihpihna ahuntak a piak ahi.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

paite: Hiai hih ding a tangkoupihpa ding leh sawltak a seh ka hi, Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen, ka zuau kei; ginna leh thutak a Zentelte sinsakpa a seh ka hi.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

paite: Pasalte'n mun chih a khut siangthou zak in, thangpai lou leh ginglel lou in thum le uh ka deih hi.
heading: Biakna A Numeite Omdan Ding
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

paite: Huchibang mah in numeite zumthei leh omdan siam in puansilh kilawm lel in kivan le uh; samphek, dangka-eng, tuikepsuang leh puan mantam taktakte a kivan lou in;
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

paite: himahleh numei Pathian limsak kichite akihun lel in thil hihhoih in kivan le uh ka deih hi.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

paite: Numei in thumang hiathiat in om dinden in zil hen.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

paite: Himahleh numei in thu ahilh zaw ka phal kei, pasal tung a thuneih leng ka phal sam kei, dai dinden in om zaw hen.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

paite: Adam siam masak ahi a, huai nung in Evi siam ahi.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

paite: Adam khem in a-om kei a, numei khem in a-om a, tatlekna ah apukta hi.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

paite: Numei in omdan siamna toh ginna leh itna leh sianthouna a a-om gigeleh nau pianna ah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
